changelog: Adds /nestor-beta:audit: an independent Codex agent, sol6.1 or astra at the chosen effort (sol6.1 xhigh by default), audits a task or plan, its specification before delivery and its delivered code after, and the report is logged in a Nestor note linked to the audited item. A pull request number in place of a reference audits that pull request's changes against its description.
